insight: One UI labels every modality — image, text, audio, video, time-series — and ML backends can pre-annotate so humans correct, not start cold.
name: Label Studio
tagline: Open-source multi-type data labeling and AI evaluation.
description: Widely-used open-source tool for labeling and annotating data across images, text, audio, video, and time-series, with a standardized export format for training and fine-tuning. ML backends can pre-label data to speed up human review, and it increasingly doubles as a human-in-the-loop AI evaluation surface. Maintained by HumanSignal, which offers a hosted Starter tier and Label Studio Enterprise.
edge: Open-source UI labels every modality (image, text, audio, video, time-series) with ML backends to pre-annotate.
pros: Covers all data modalities in one tool
ML backends pre-label to speed review
Free community edition; clean Enterprise path
cons: Advanced QA/consensus gated to paid tiers
Less CV-specialized than CVAT or Encord
